notes.title: Community Items for Player Profiles! 🚀🎮
notes.notes:
Hello, gamers! 🎮✨ We're excited to announce that we've released new community items for decorating your storage! 🌟

To obtain these items, active participation in our game is required! Join us to collect unique items and unleash your gaming potential. Choose the ones you like and create a unique atmosphere for your profile! 🔥

Thank you for your support and for participating in the improvement of our game! 💼

notes.title: Exciting news! This Saturday brings out new experiences - Sex College 🔞 is near
notes.notes:
Months of immense work went past, and the game is now on the doorstep - we tried to take notice of your complaints about certain issues with Sex Magic, and we hope you'll enjoy our new game even more.
Are you ready to dive into the whirlwinds of student life in college? In a few days you'll be able to get to know the diverse characters, their personalities and much beyond that, if you cath our drift 😏
We've put some serious work into graphics, a fascinating story and detailed immersive 18+ scenes, and we really hope you'll enjoy them a lot.

Don't miss the release, and you might get some tasty surprises along with it!

With best regards, Lust Desires 🖤
